acceptedEngineeringFacts: A canonical decision-evidence firewall is now applied before frozen-decision promotion.
Every KNOWN decision-supporting factor must be pointInTimeEligible=true.
Every KNOWN decision-supporting factor must have a valid availableAt not later than decisionTimestamp.
Every KNOWN factor must carry immutable source identity and source payload hash.
The exact factorId@factorVersion must be authorized by the frozen decision refs and strategy contract.
Every KNOWN evidence-family assessment must map to exact supporting factor observation hashes.
Any firewall blocker forces the effective frozen decision state to INCOMPLETE and clears rank/score.
Prediction snapshots expose decisionEvidence state/hash/blockers and block outcome joins unless decision evidence is READY.

d03CanonicalInterpretation.knownTechnicalFactorRule: A technical factor may be KNOWN for a frozen decision only when its exact observation was available by the decision clock and its source/version/hash lineage is bound.
d03CanonicalInterpretation.noBackdating: A later observation cannot be relabelled as decision-time KNOWN merely because the underlying price date is earlier.
d03CanonicalInterpretation.familyRule: A KNOWN trend/momentum/indicator family label without exact supporting factor hashes is non-admissible.
d03CanonicalInterpretation.diagnosticRule: Non-PIT or future observations may remain archived as diagnostic/UNKNOWN evidence but may not support selection, ranking, capacity or outcome-join eligibility.

D03-01_to_D03-04.requirement: MA/retN/persistence/continuation observations used in any future frozen decision must satisfy the decision-evidence firewall at the exact factor version and clock.

D03-09_ADX.requirement: A replay-certified ADX value remains inadmissible if its factor observation becomes available only after the decision clock; exact Wilder lineage and decision-clock admissibility are independent gates.

D03-10_BOLLINGER.requirement: Exact 20-session Bollinger values may support a frozen decision only if the observation itself is PIT-eligible and available no later than the decision clock; exact-window correctness and decision-time availability are separate gates.
